approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: KNOW-22 (Leif chose Approve as proposed, 2026-11-05 16:34 MST): a new requirement for how the librarian trim treats observations and fixtures of verified, duplicate and wont-fix bugs.
acceptance_criteria: In the librarian trim a verified, duplicate or wont-fix bug no longer protects its linked observations; its earliest linked failure with artifacts, for a verified bug its first linked pass after it, and its fixture under .chough move into knowledge/attachments/<bug folder>/ when they would otherwise be trimmed; other linked observations are trimmed and ledgered when cold; library index writes bugs/<id>.md linking what moved; open bugs and evidence prune keep every link. The new tests fail first and fledge lanes run verify passes on Linux.

answers.constraints: KNOW-22; Leif chose Approve as proposed (2026-11-05 16:34 MST, via the orc); REQ-cli-046 move rules (never overwrite, keep modes, ledger, restore) and evidence prune protections unchanged.
